title: Concept: Composer lockfile entry without a distribution reference
description: composer.lock declares a locked package whose distribution records no commit reference, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Nothing pins the archive to a specific commit, so the same version string can serve different contents on different days.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.lock (composer).
risk: Nothing pins the archive to a specific commit, so the same version string can serve different contents on different days.
